_comment: PURPOSE: lists the server's packages and scripts. JSON cannot hold comments, so the notes live in this array.
HOW: In server/, run `npm init -y`, which replaces this file. Then set "name": "server" and add "type": "module" (ES modules, so `import` works).
PACKAGES (npm install): express, mongoose, multer, dotenv, cors.
NO AI PACKAGE HERE: Gemini is called from the Python agent (agent/requirements.txt). The server reaches the agent with Node 20's built-in fetch.
DEV PACKAGE (npm install -D): nodemon. It restarts the server when you save a file.
NODE VERSION: Node 20 or newer. Optionally add "engines": { "node": ">=20" }.
TALKS TO: server.js (the entry file). The settings come from .env (copy .env.example).
